heading: Voice of America/Europe
lead: As part of its duties and programs under this subchapter, Voice of America/Europe shall—

tree.text: target news and features in accordance with the findings and recommendations of the Young European Survey;
conduct periodic audience evaluations and measurements; and
promote and advertise Voice of America/Europe.
